headlines.headline: Klay Thompson clears buyout, headed to Heat alongside Giannis
headlines.detail: Thompson is finalizing a two-year, ~$13M deal with Miami after a Mavericks buyout, joining the roster the Heat built around July's Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.

headlines.headline: 10-game preseason Week 2 slate highlighted by Jayden Daniels' return
headlines.detail: Daniels expected to play for Washington at Detroit in his first action since Dec. 7. Nick Chubb announced his retirement Friday after eight NFL seasons.

headlines.headline: Ohio State opens at No. 1 in preseason AP Top 25
headlines.detail: Buckeyes get 40 first-place votes ahead of Oregon, Georgia, Notre Dame and Texas; reigning champ Indiana is No. 6 as the Big Ten places 8 teams to the SEC's 9.

headlines.headline: Duke opens at No. 1 in Andy Katz's preseason Power 44
headlines.detail: Earliest signal of the 2026-27 pecking order; transfer portal stays active with Georgia Tech's Lamar Washington (Boise State) and Columbia's Kenny Noland (Michigan).
